sourceDocuments.title: Climate Drivers of Meningitis Outbreaks in the Sahel
sourceDocuments.text: Meningococcal meningitis epidemics in the African Meningitis Belt occur during dry harmattan dust winds that damage respiratory mucosal defenses and facilitate Neisseria meningitidis bacterial invasion.
